newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Guoco up 7.84 pct in late session.
newsitem.headline: Guoco up 7.84 pct in late session.

text.p: Guoco Holdings rose by 40 centavos, or 7.84 percent, to 5.50 pesos on Thursday on reports that a controversial property in which the company was involved had been cleared by Philippine President Fidel Ramos, brokers said.
Guoco subsidiary Centennial City had entered into a deal with another company, Amari Coastal Bay Development Corporation, to jointly develop a property leased from the government.
Guoco and Centennial's shares were affected after a senator said there was an anomaly in the leasing of the property and that the government was losing money.
On Thursday, local newspapers reported that President Ramos said he was not aware of any such anomaly.
"Guoco had a problem with Centennial City because of this reclaimed property deal. Now, the stock is recovering," one broker said.
The reports spurred buying in shares of Centennial City as well. In late trade, it was up 25 centavos, or 7.04 percent, at 3.80 pesos.
A total of 1.75 million Guoco shares and 9.94 million Centennial shares changed hands.
